<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl groups, I will retrieve the typical 13C chemical shift range for carbonyl carbons using the retrieve_carbon_shifts tool. Then I will obtain the actual 13C NMR spectrum of the sample with carbon_nmr_spectra and count how many peaks fall within that carbonyl range. This will give the number of carbonyl carbons, which corresponds to the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
<action>retrieve_carbon_shifts</action>
